messages:
sara: Quick heads-up — we're scheduling a short maintenance window for the control-plane routing tier tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC. This is a planned config push to fix a routing regression that shows up under burst traffic. No expected customer downtime but there will be brief rolling restarts and possible elevated latencies for 2-5 minutes per region. Please review the comms below and ack if you can take oncall coverage/notifications. mike: ack — I can take the 02:00->03:30 block for oncall handoff and monitor latency. I'll be primary pager. elaine: thanks. I'll draft the status page and customer email and drop them here for edit. support_lead: putting a pin in customer comms — prefer we call it a "brief service refresh" and emphasise no expected interruption, but mention possible transient increased latencies for inference requests. That reduces churn. josh: ops-bot: run preflight checks 1h before and post-checks after? ops-bot: @josh preflight checklist will run at 01:00 UTC: cluster health, model-serving process counts, KV cache hit rates. Post-check at 03:15 UTC. I will post results to #eng-oncall. pagerbot: Reminder: scheduled paging suppression will be enabled during the window to avoid noisy alerts. Critical alerts still route; non-critical latency alerts will be suppressed. elaine: Draft status page update (please copy/edit): ``` Summary: Brief scheduled service refresh for control-plane routing to address burst-routing regression. Start: 02:00 UTC, YYYY-MM-DD End: 03:00 UTC, YYYY-MM-DD (approx) Impact: Short (2-5m) periods of elevated inference latency may be observed in affected regions during rolling restarts. No customer-facing downtime expected. What we're doing: Rolling config push and graceful restarts of routing proxies. If you see issues: Open a support ticket and reference INC-PLANNED-. ``` mike: small edit: change "graceful restarts" -> "graceful restart with automatic fallback to backup route" so customers know we have fallback. elaine: updated. customer email template below — please review tone and content. ``` Subject: Planned maintenance — brief service refresh (no expected downtime) Hello,

We will perform a brief maintenance on our control-plane routing layer on YYYY-MM-DD from 02:00–03:00 UTC. During this window, you may notice short (2–5 minute) periods of increased request latency as we perform rolling, graceful restarts. There is no expected downtime and we have automatic fallback routes in place to keep traffic flowing. Why: Fixing a regression that can affect bursty workloads' routing decisions. What to do: No action required. If you experience sustained errors or degraded performance beyond the window, please reply to this email or open a support ticket referencing INC-PLANNED-. Thanks, The Redwood Inference Team ``` support_lead: tone looks good. suggest adding links to status page and support docs. Also include expected latencies numbers if we have them (e.g., +200–500ms). elaine: added support link and a short metric blurb. New copy attached below: feel free to snip. ``` We estimate a transient latency increase of ~200–500ms for affected requests during restarts. This is short-lived and should not impact throughput. Link: https://status.redwood.inference/updates/INC-PLANNED- ``` mike: ops checklist for oncall during window (quick): - 01:00 UTC: confirm preflight (ops-bot posted) - 01:45 UTC: join quick preflight huddle (zoom link in calendar) - 02:00 UTC: start rolling push, monitor per-region P95/P99 and request error rate - If error rate spikes >0.5% sustained for 2m -> revert and page SRE-2 - 03:00 UTC: finish expected window, run post-checks, confirm KV cache warm josh: I'll be on standby for rollbacks and will coordinate with infra to hold a node if needed. pagerbot: Posting scheduled maintenance to status page at 20:00 UTC today unless there's last-minute change. If anyone needs earlier publish, flag now. elaine: please don't publish until comms review done. support_lead can you give final sign-off by 18:00 UTC? support_lead: will review and sign-off by 17:45 UTC. mike: one more note — enable client retry-backoff guidance in the support doc: `retry with exponential backoff up to 10s` in case customers see transient 429/503. elaine: added to the support doc. Final checklist: sign-off, publish status update, send customer email 90 minutes before window, enable suppression and run ops-bot preflight. Who will send the customer email? support_lead: I can send the customer email at 00:30 UTC. mike will monitor the send for any surge in support tickets. mike: got it. I'll be in channel and monitoring. sara: thanks all. I'll post a quick internal summary in #eng-oncall just before handoff and will update the status page on completion with final verification. ops-bot: Post-check results (03:15 UTC): all routing proxies healthy, P95 within expected range, KV cache warmed, no elevated error rates. mike: confirm — observed two brief 3m latency spikes in us-west1 during restart, both recovered and no retries leaked. Closing loop with support. support_lead: final note for the status page completion message: keep it short and include a link to the postmortem if we decide to formalize. Example: `Maintenance complete. No customer impact observed beyond short latency blips. Monitoring continues.` elaine: will post completion note after ops-bot results. thanks everyone :thumbsup: pagerbot: Maintenance window completed and update published to status page. sara: thread closed — great work team.
